category_title: Struggling readers who use speech recognition to test and confirm their own diction
scenario_title: Persistent repetition to confirm diction during SR drafting
minimal_context: Alyson is using speech recognition on an iPad in the writing center to dictate her version of Mary Had a Little Lamb.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's work on your version of Mary Had a Little Lamb using the speech recognition on your iPad.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Dictates into the iPad) Carla had a baby pit bull.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and check what it typed.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Erases the transcription) It wrote 'hey baby pit bull.' (Dictates again) a baby pit bull.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Deletes the incorrect text again) a baby pit bull. (Erases the transcription and repeats dictating the same phrase 10 to 15 times to see her oral language transcribed accurately)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's work on your version of Mary Had a Little Lamb using the speech recognition on your iPad.

STUDENT: (Dictates into the iPad) Carla had a baby pit bull.

TUTOR: Go ahead and check what it typed.

STUDENT: (Erases the transcription) It wrote 'hey baby pit bull.' (Dictates again) a baby pit bull.

TUTOR: Try it again.

STUDENT: (Deletes the incorrect text again) a baby pit bull. (Erases the transcription and repeats dictating the same phrase 10 to 15 times to see her oral language transcribed accurately)

task.content: worked on her version of Mary Had a Little Lamb by dictating, "Carla had a baby pit bull."

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: SR consistently wrote, "Carla had hey baby pit bull."
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Ten to 15 times, Alyson deleted the incorrect text and dictated, "a baby pit bull."
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: She wanted to see her oral language transcribed accurately. SR was not being used to compose but to confirm her diction for a.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: commonly erased inaccurate transcriptions and repeated dictations of single words, phrases, or sentences over 15 times
